source.author: stat
source.text: Atropos hos atque ipsa novat Proserpina cultus, tunc geminas quatit ira manus: haec igne rogali fulgurat, haec vivo manus aera verberat hydro.
source.text_original: Atropos hos atque ipsa novat Proserpina cultus, / tunc geminas quatit ira manus: haec igne rogali / fulgurat, haec vivo manus aera verberat hydro.
source.text_english: Atropos renews these rites, and Proserpina herself too; then anger shakes her twin hands: one hand flashes with the funeral pyre’s fire, the other strikes living bronze with water.
